keySentence: The rabbit wanted to be real more than anything.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The rabbit was thrown away. He cried a real tear. He wanted to be real so badly. The rabbit wanted to be real more than anything.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The doctor said all the old toys must be thrown away. The rabbit was placed in a bag in the garden. A real tear fell from the rabbit's button eye. The rabbit wanted to be real more than anything in the world. He remembered all the happy days with his beloved boy. But something magical was about to happen because of that tear.
